countries_thin_or_null: Belarus — Belstat continues to publish national accounts under SNA 2008 and maintains SDDS metadata, but international engagement constrained since 2020-21; still functional primary source material exists

North Korea — No known functioning national statistics office publishing internationally-standard primary data through normal channels; only external estimates (UN Population Division, World Bank) found — not North Korea's own primary source

proposed_reports.title: National Statistical Committee of the Republic of Belarus (Belstat)
proposed_reports.publisher: National Statistical Committee of the Republic of Belarus
proposed_reports.description: National statistical committee responsible for the System of National Accounts, CPI, labour and other official statistics. Continues to publish under SNA 2008 framework.

proposed_reports.title: National accounts of the Republic of Belarus (SNA 2008)
proposed_reports.publisher: National Statistical Committee of the Republic of Belarus
proposed_reports.description: Annual national accounts publication compiled according to the System of National Accounts 2008; data for 2010 onward revised to SNA 2008.

dependencies.basis: Belstat methodology and DQAF-style statements confirm national accounts compiled under SNA 2008 from 2016 onward (with back-revision of earlier years).
dependencies.evidence_quote: Начиная с I квартала 2016 г. данные формируются по Системе национальных счетов 2008 года (СНС-2008). Данные за 2009-2015 гг. приведены в соответствии с СНС-2008

dependencies.basis: Belarus remains an SDDS subscriber with active metadata on the DSBB (subscription 2004); labour, BOP and other category DQAF pages continue to reference SDDS observance.
National Bank of Belarus (in coordination with Belstat) compiles balance of payments according to BPM6.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The Balance of Payments is compiled in accordance with international standards set out in the sixth edition of The Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Manual (BPM6)
